endorsements.name: Akram Hamdi
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-36747
endorsements.description: ShineLan-X contains a set of credentials for an FTP server was found within the firmware, allowing testers to establish an insecure FTP connection with the server. This may allow an attacker to replace legitimate files being deployed to devices with their own malicious versions, since the firmware signature verification is not enforced.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 4.0, 9.4)

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.

endorsements.name: Akram Hamdi
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-36750
endorsements.description: ShineLan-X contains a stored cross site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the Plant Name field. A HTML payload will be displayed on the plant management page via a direct post. This may allow attackers to force a legitimate user’s browser’s JavaScript engine to run malicious code.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.5)
